verdict.rationale: Metronome documents API-driven subscription lifecycle management, including pricing changes, upgrades and downgrades. Changing a rate card price propagates to all contracts at the next billing period, and per-contract rate overrides could hold a cohort on old pricing as a workaround. However, global inheritance is the opposite of default grandfathering, and there is no evidence of versioned plans or dedicated cohort-migration tooling. Missing for 10: explicit plan/rate-card versioning, native grandfathering of existing subscribers, bulk cohort migration tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.
